title: AuditEventFact
description: One account fact, as the client sees it — shared by `GET /audit-events` (plan 06, B-40; plan 07, B-17) and `GET /permission-rules/:ruleId/history` (plan 15, B-11), which reads the same facts filtered by `subjectId`. The owner is the caller, so it is not here.

kind.description: A genuinely open vocabulary — `file.`, `file.written`, a device or a rule event — never a fixed enum.

subjectId.description: What the fact is about — for a file, its real path; for a rule's own history, the rule itself.

subjectLabel.description: How to show the subject — for a file, its path; for a rule, its pattern at the moment of the fact.

details.description: Sizes, hashes, origin and destination, before/after values — never the contents of a file. Open: shaped by the kind.
